description:
Free Windows x64 VNC viewer with tabbed sessions and connection history.

VNC4FREE is a Windows x64 desktop viewer for connecting to computers that already run a VNC server. It supports standard RFB 3.3, 3.7 and 3.8 sessions, including classic VNC password authentication, and can reach plain TCP, TLS, WebSocket and Secure WebSocket endpoints.
Saved connection profiles, groups, favorites and search live in an address book, with up to 16 sessions in tabs, Send keys shortcuts, view-only mode, clipboard transfer, fullscreen and PNG screenshot capture.
VNC4FREE is free to download and use on Windows x64.
Download the setup executable under Assets. The installer defaults to C:\Program Files (x86)\VNC4FREE, accepts a custom folder, and offers an optional desktop shortcut.
Setup requests administrator approval. The executable is unsigned, so Windows may display a SmartScreen prompt.
